title: Understanding Other Minds
description: Explore the deep questions: What is intelligence? Can machines think? How do we test for consciousness? Trace from Turing's philosophical thought experiment through modern debates about AI sentience.
targetAudience: Philosophers and AI enthusiasts exploring consciousness questions
keyTakeaways: Turing proposed behavior as the test for thinking
The ELIZA effect shows humans readily attribute understanding
Mirror self-recognition reveals something about self-awareness
The consciousness question remains philosophically open
